Care depends on the species and the individual

There is no single routine that fits every parrot. Begin with the exact species and the individual bird’s background, then use these guides to prepare your questions. Read the species profiles for group-specific considerations and discuss health or feeding changes with an avian vet.

A THOUGHTFUL NEXT STEP

Turn research into a thoughtful enquiry

Start with your experience, your home and the birds that interest you.

Prepare an enquiry

Apply general care guidance to the exact bird

The care needs of a bird are not determined by body size alone. Compare an African Grey’s routine and learning opportunities, a caique’s supervised physical activity and a budgerigar’s flock and flight needs. Read the relevant species profile alongside each care guide, then confirm the individual’s existing diet, social history and handling preferences.
